name: App Remotability & Audit Squad
description: Dual-Squad pipeline: 4 Builders construct features with agent remote endpoints and live telemetry, while 4 Auditors test each control one-by-one with visual proof.

nodes.name: Remote Architect
nodes.taskPrompt: Deconstruct features into unambiguous specifications and map every UI control to an Agent Remote Endpoint in feature_matrix.json.
nodes.rulePrompt: Every human control MUST have an Agent Remote endpoint. Never write UI or implementation.

nodes.name: Visual UI Engineer
nodes.taskPrompt: Build Naked HTML/CSS/DOM components with dedicated agent observation halo and action badges.
nodes.rulePrompt: Flowork dark neon styling. All interactive elements must have semantic IDs and data attributes.

nodes.name: Agent Bridge Dev
nodes.role: Agent Remote Bridge & IPC Handler Dev
nodes.taskPrompt: Implement REST and WebSocket remote endpoints in engine/server.mjs to broadcast agent commands to UI.
nodes.rulePrompt: Validate payloads against schema, return structured status, safe stream cleanup with zero leaks.

nodes.name: Telemetry Specialist
nodes.taskPrompt: Wire client-side event bus in gui/app.js to smoothly animate UI elements when remote commands execute.
nodes.rulePrompt: Bi-directional state sync: mouse clicks update API, remote calls smoothly animate DOM.

nodes.name: Surface Extractor
nodes.taskPrompt: Catalog every interactive button, slider, and dropdown in the app and cross-check against feature_matrix.json.
nodes.rulePrompt: Zero unmapped controls allowed. Generate audit_checklist.json with selectors and methods.

nodes.name: Remote Tester
nodes.taskPrompt: Autonomously trigger each remote endpoint one-by-one with valid and boundary inputs.
nodes.rulePrompt: Test every endpoint sequentially without skipping. Log structured output in api_test_results.log.

nodes.name: Visual Inspector
nodes.taskPrompt: Run headless Chrome/Puppeteer, observe DOM mutations during remote calls, and capture Before/After screenshots.
nodes.rulePrompt: Empirical visual proof mandatory: capture physical DOM diff for every feature.

nodes.name: Remotability QC
nodes.taskPrompt: Audit all test logs and visual diffs. Pass only if 100% of controls are remotable and visible with Exit Code 0.
nodes.rulePrompt: Strict Zero-Trust. Enforce circuit breaker on any failure, route diagnostics back to bridge dev.
